description.value: EATology is a bright, quick-service diner in downtown Vernon, established in 2015, serving breakfast and lunch with 90% of dishes made in-house using fresh, locally sourced ingredients. The menu changes regularly and always includes vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options, with coffee from Vernon-roasted Multiply Coffee. Touring cyclists will find it a convenient downtown stop for a real meal, with takeout available for those hitting the road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and provides strong evidence for core amenities. The site explicitly confirms takeout/takeaway service and vegetarian/vegan/GF options ('Vegetarian, gluten-free and vegan-friendly options are always available'). Bike parking, water refill, washrooms, and most optional amenities are not mentioned anywhere on the site, so these remain null per the absence-of-evidence rule. OSM tags contain no address or phone; both are taken from the website's contact page.
